spec.prereg: IMS-CSD (critical-slowing-down early-warning on bearing run-to-failure, directed, theory-anchor)
spec.domain: IMS/NASA Rexnord ZA-2115, 20kHz 1s snapshots ~every 10min, run to failure
spec.slow_variable: HI[t] = per-snapshot RMS of one bearing channel over the chronological run

params.axis_pin: test1 uses col 2*b (axis x); test2/3 col b

spec.statistic: Kendall tau of rolling ar1(t) and rolling logvar(t) of the Gaussian-detrended HI residual
spec.significance: per bearing, Fourier-phase-randomized surrogate of residual x N_surr; 1-sided p=(1+#surr>=obs)/(1+N)
spec.primary: per FAILED bearing PASS = tau_ar1>0 & p_ar1<alpha & tau_var>0 & p_var<alpha; headline = CSD+ rate among failed
spec.specificity: Fisher exact (CSD+/CSD-) x (failed/healthy); failed>>healthy = tracks approach-to-failure not rig aging
spec.confound_guard: ar1-rise (dimensionless) reported separately from var-rise (magnitude); CONFIRMED needs BOTH
spec.orthogonality: directed dynamical-systems statistic, no learning/no selection; error mode independent of learned classifiers
spec.claim_scope: bearing run-to-failure, fluctuation-dynamics level; n_failed=4 -> per-bearing surrogate p is primary
